summary: Frontend hotfix verification for Checkout.jsx (loading→submitting rename + auth-hydration gate). All 4 requested checks PASS. Checkout compiles and renders, testids present, delivery↔pickup toggle hides address+map, COD delivery order placed end-to-end and appears in /orders as Pending, and hard-refresh direct nav to /checkout with an item in cart does NOT bounce authenticated user to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx line 27 useEffect properly gates on `if (loading) return;` before redirecting to /login — good fix, prevents auth-hydration race on hard-refresh.
`submitting` state cleanly separated from auth `loading`; button correctly disables during submit and shows 'Processing…' label.

Minor: on-refresh /checkout still momentarily shows the full form even before auth hydration completes; consider rendering a small skeleton/spinner while `loading===true` so users don't see a flash of empty state (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: 1 COD delivery order created for buyer aling.nena@laguna.ph (order #33f7be15, ₱42.50, TEST_Product_3f1b0c) — appears as Pending in /orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hotfix iteration 3: renamed duplicate `loading` in Checkout.jsx to `submitting` and added auth-hydration gate. Verified: (a) /checkout compiles & renders without PAGEERROR, (b) all data-testids present: fulfill-delivery, fulfill-pickup, address-field, phone-field, pay-online, pay-cod, place-order-btn, checkout-total, map-picker, pin-coords, (c) pickup toggle hides address+map, (d) COD delivery order placed successfully → toast 'Order placed! Pay on delivery.' → navigate to /orders → new order visible as Pending, (e) hard-navigation to /checkout while logged-in with cart item does NOT bounce to /login. Previous iteration_2 backend 18/18 unchanged — backend not re-tested this pass. Note: market has a couple of 'Out of stock' products at index 0 and 1 (TEST_UI_Product_81da16, tomato) with disabled add-to-cart buttons — tests should filter with :not([disabled]).
